title: Strates — Vue libre
description: A full-information variant of Strates, the 3D connection game with gravity. Orbit the board continuously, tilt and zoom to inspect the stacks, then place, move or mine cubes from the chosen angle. The AI and both online players share the complete board. Hotseat, Easy/Normal AI and LOB7 rooms.
controls: Drag the board to orbit continuously and tilt. Use the wheel or +/− buttons to zoom; Reset view or Home restores the camera. Arrow keys rotate and tilt.
Click the ground or the top of a column to place a cube; click one of your cubes on a side face then a ghost target to move; double-click, press M or use the button to mine.
This variant shares all cube positions with both players and the AI. Rotate to see around stacks. Hotseat: pass the device between turns.
credits: A game by Cédric Bernadac, created with AI agents (ZCode & Kimi K3.1 Pro).
Free-view camera and corrected cube geometry: Nilo (Codex).
